items.statement: Construct genuine common R/S and original fiber D_y before epsilon/f; choose ONE actual u before ALL C2 compact cutoffs. Retain all-domain variational identity, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, locally integrable squared r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and all original C2 compact distribution tests. For every C2 compact chi retain v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi, all three global-volume L2/support inclusions, all C1 localized weak-gradient and C2 localized PDE identities with legal products. For each cutoff, Construct actual vc,Fc in complex L2(volume), with vc=volume-a.e. ofReal(v) and Fc=volume-a.e. ofReal(Fchi). For every complex Schwartz psi, both (Delta psi)*ofReal(v) and psi*ofReal(Fchi) are L1 and their integrals equal. For T_v=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc) and T_F=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(Fc), derive Delta T_v=T_F and MemSobolev 2 2 T_v. The latter uses B2 T=T-(2pi)^(-2) Delta T and a genuine complex L2 witness, not a supplied regularity result. Reflected/RGO laws/operators/quarter Hessian and Dirichlet scales remain distinct.
assumptions: E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. V is C2 with alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, all-point/all-vector alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I; eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

Construct the true Gaussian/Gibbs augmentation J, common Markov/disintegrating R/S, exact reflected S_y=(2x-y)#R_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), C2 and positive integrable partition.

For every fiber fix original dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure before epsilon/forcing. For each epsilon>0/f in L2(S_y), one actual u/G/r serves all C2 compact chi. Derive all local/global volume facts and PDE inputs from the accepted actual conditional localization. No measurable joint fiberwise solution/class selector, unreflected RGO identity or localized weighted-domain membership is assumed.

formulae.label: Actual PBPS reflected resolvent: localized complex Sobolev
formulae.tex: \exists R,S\ \forall y\ \exists D_y\ \forall\varepsilon>0,f\ \exists u\ \forall\chi\in C_c^2\ \exists v_C,F_C:\quad v=\chi u,\ F_\chi=\chi r+2\langle\nabla\chi,G\rangle+u\Delta\chi,\quad\Delta T_v=T_{F_\chi},\quad\mathrm{MemSobolev}\ 2\ 2\ T_v.
